title: Law to require a battery disposal plan for e-bikes and scooters
summary: This bill would require the Department of Sanitation to create a plan for the proper disposal of rechargeable batteries used in motorized bicycles, scooters and similar mobility devices. The plan must include at least two collection sites per borough open seven days a week, battery collection at disposal events, coordination with retailers on in-store collection, and a public education campaign in the city's designated languages. The law would take effect immediately upon passage.
